svg.aria-label: Zerodha Kite at the open bell: the clock reaches 9:15:00 and orders per second jump about eleven-fold; an order flows app, gateway, RMS, OMS to the exchange and the acknowledgement returns as OPEN; below, one exchange feed reaches a ticker that keeps only the latest prices and sends each screen one binary message a second, skipping a slow one

svg.text: ONE TAP, ONE ORDER · PRICES MAY DROP, ORDERS NEVER
